title: A pulsing ruler
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Cepheid variables have a relationship between pulsation period and intrinsic luminosity. Once calibrated, their observed brightness can help determine distances.

misconception: A learner may choose: They all sit at the same distance from Earth
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What makes Cepheid variable stars useful for distance measurements?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What makes Cepheid variable stars useful for distance measurements? Their pulsation period relates to their intrinsic luminosity. Cepheid variables have a relationship between pulsation period and intrinsic luminosity. Once calibrated, their observed brightness can help determine distances.
Visual caption: Pulse period → luminosity. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
